info.title: Haya Bila Alam - حياة بلا ألم API
info.description: Complete API reference for all platform modules. Doctor and Patient mobile APIs are grouped by sub-module tags (e.g. Doctor App - Appointments, Patient App - Auth). Auto-discovered routes are merged with hand-written schemas.

doctor.description: Doctor profile with speciality and user fields

PatientAppointmentFilter.description:
`coming` filters appointments whose datetime is soon (within PATIENT_COMING_WINDOW_HOURS).
It is NOT an appointment status. Other values filter by AppointmentStatus.

file.description: Single report file (Swagger Try it out). Use field `files` for multiple uploads.

files.description: One or more report files (repeat this part for multiple files).

titles.description: Optional JSON array of titles aligned with uploaded files

tags.name: Patient App - Appointments
tags.description: Book and manage clinic or remote appointments

tags.name: Doctor App - Patients
tags.description: Patient list and details for treating doctors

get.summary: List medical profile report attachments for a patient

post.summary: Upload medical profile report attachments for a patient

delete.summary: Delete a patient medical profile attachment

post.description: Patient app uses 5-digit stub `12345` when OTP provider is mock. Legacy auth uses the same code length.

post.summary: Send a message in a support case

get.summary: Get reviews for a specific doctor
Get system settings (public filtered by default)

post.summary: Create a system setting (Super Admin only)

patch.summary: Mark a single notification as read

put.summary: Update medical profile (JSON only, structured fields)
put.description: Legacy mirror of Patient App profile update. Use attachment sub-routes for files.

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive account, or pending admin approval

get.summary: Get support ticket detail with messages

200.description: Each item includes doctor name, specializations, datetime, fees, status, isComing

post.description: Requires doctor and time slot. Home visits use POST /patient/home-services instead.

get.summary: Get or join video consultation session

post.summary: Patient login with mobile number (PATIENT role only)
post.description: Returns token, refreshToken, and patient profile. Doctor and staff accounts are rejected.

403.description: Account is not authorized for the patient app

post.description: Use stub code `12345` when OTP provider is mock (until SMS verification is implemented).

200.description: Records with doctor details (not patient details)
Family members with residence card number and derived age

post.description: Date-only booking with visit address. Use POST /patient/appointments for clinic or remote visits.

serviceId.description: Must be a HOME type service

200.description: Insurance list with company, label number, expiry, active status

get.summary: Get medical profile (catalog IDs and resolved items)

put.description:
JSON only. Updates chronic diseases, medications, allergies, and text fields.
Upload or delete report attachments via `/medical-profile/attachments` sub-routes.

post.summary: Upload medical report attachments (one or more)

delete.summary: Delete a medical profile report attachment

get.summary: Personal details (name, identity, phone, age, gender)
Doctors in specialization with available appointment count
Get support ticket detail with messages
